translations.web: Repent therefore, or else I am coming to you quickly, and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.
translations.bsb: Therefore repent! Otherwise I will come to you shortly and wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.
translations.kjv: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
